cardOverview.overviewText: A TravelOne card from HSBC designed for frequent travelers, providing lounge access, travel insurance, and accelerated rewards on travel bookings.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Travel Booking, Airline Transfer, Hotel Transfer

items.child: Save 20% on duty-free shopping via the AdaniOne app or website (minimum order value INR 8,000; once per card per year; max savings INR 3,000).

benefitRows.name: AdaniOne
benefitRows.description: Save 20% on duty-free shopping via the AdaniOne app or website (minimum order value INR 8,000; once per card per year; max savings INR 3,000).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the AdaniOne app or website with your registered account. Shop duty-free products with a minimum order value of ₹8,000. Use your HSBC TravelOne credit card to get 20% off (valid once per card per year; maximum savings ₹3,000). For support, contact HSBC customer care at 1800 103 4724.

benefitRows.name: Airport Transfer
